title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Experience in Python, C++, Java, or Go; pursuing a degree in CS or related technical discipline.
description: Join Google's core engineering team for a 12-14 week summer internship to work on large-scale software solutions and developer tools.

title: Chevening UK Government Postgraduate Scholarship 2025/2026
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with a completed undergraduate degree and 2+ years of work experience.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition fees, monthly stipend, flights)
qualification: Undergraduate degree meeting entry requirements for UK Master's programs.
description: Chevening offers full financial support for outstanding emerging leaders to pursue any eligible master's degree at any UK university.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with work authorization in their residence country.
qualification: 1+ years of experience with React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Git version control.
description: Work remotely with GitLab's distributed frontend team to create modern web interfaces and improve UX performance across the open-core product.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent university graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of relevant work experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related quantitative field.
description: Lead cross-functional engineering and design teams to define core product features and drive user-centric software innovation.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Innovation Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university globally.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure mentorship
qualification: Students working individually or in teams of up to 4 using AI and Cloud technologies.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build innovative AI-driven social impact or commercial software projects.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to all learners worldwide with no prior programming knowledge required.
description: An entry-level computer science course introducing algorithmic thinking, data structures, and languages like C, Python, SQL, HTML, and JavaScript.
